skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and master the framework, standards, and stages of the risk management process in insurance businesses; Proficient in risk management tools.
Master techniques for identifying, analyzing, and evaluating risks in insurance business operations; Apply risk analysis techniques in insurance business operations.
Apply risk management knowledge to advise on risk management in insurance business operations.
Develop skills in synthesis, analysis, and systematic thinking; Ability to manage resources for professional activities in insurance risk management.
Demonstrate self-reliance when working independently, show personal responsibility and responsibility towards the group.
Express and defend personal views based on an objective and scientific approach to risk management activities in insurance businesses.
